title: The 30 m vegetation maps of the Tibetan Plateau (1990-2020)
abstract: A new region vegetation mapping method based on terrain-climate-remote sensing was developed in this study, supported by the GEE (Google Earth Engine) and the random forest algorithm, combined with terrain, climate, and Landsat remote sensing image data, a detailed vegetation mapping of the Tibetan Plateau was completed at a resolution of 30 meters from 1990 to 2020. The overall accuracy and Kappa coefficient reached 95.00% and 0.95, respectively. The data includes vegetation maps of the Tibetan Plateau (in TIFF format, 4 periods, each spanning 10 years ), classification, and post-processing codes. This dataset can provide a basis for dynamic monitoring of vegetation on the Tibetan Plateau.
provider: Taiyuan University of Technology; Chinese Academy of Meteorological Sciences
citation: Ren, H., Wu, F., Zhou, G. (2024). The 30 m vegetation maps of the Tibetan Plateau (1990-2020). National Tibetan Plateau / Third Pole Environment Data Center. https://doi.org/10.11888/Terre.tpdc.301126.
